name: Onboarding Carousel
description: A dark React Native onboarding where each swipe moves a moonlit greyscale day forward, a grove grows in one accent, and every step's copy and figures stagger in.

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark centred in the top bar.

props.name: steps
props.description: Kicker, title, body, clock minutes, a greyscale scene (sky, land, sun and moon positions, stars, mist) and a glass chip (breath | focus | week | reminder) per step. Three or four steps read best.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour (6-digit hex): the grove, the brand mark, the chip badge and best-day bar, and the last step's button and planting flourish.

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: Top-right glass pill; jumps to the last step through every sky in between.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Button label on every step but the last.

props.name: finishLabel
props.description: Button label on the last step.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Label after the final press, while the flourish plays.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Called about a second after the final press, once the leaves have settled.

props.name: step
props.description: Jumps the carousel to this step (0-based) whenever the value changes. Leave unset and only the person moves it. Any jump clears a planted grove, so the last step's button is ready again.

props.name: stepKey
props.description: Change this number to jump to `step` again when its value has not changed, for example behind a replay button.
